newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JULY 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JULY 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the July 5 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The mafia is responsible for illegal imports of infected beef to Russia from Britain in contravention of a 1996 ban.
- The government will liberalise Russia's market of precious metals, allowing citizens to save by buying gold and silver bars.
- Zelenograd, a centre of the electronics industry north of Moscow, will be declared a special economic zone with tax breaks to encourage Western investors.
